rows.grounds: Gloss 'by-these-statements-this'; etad inst.pl.m/n + vākyaiḥ inst.pl.n + idam nom.sg.n; compound/phrase split by surface form.
Gloss 'and-stated'; ca = (indecl.), ukta = pp. nom.sg.n of √vac (stated).
Gloss 'samaya-initiate'; from samayin- 'one bound by/initiate of a samaya', nom.sg.m.
Gloss 'like-a-prince'; adverbial compound rājaputra + vat, indeclinable comparative/likeness suffix -vat.
Gloss 'would-be-in-son-and-other-three-stages'; syāt = 3sg.opt.act. of √as; putrakādi-padatraye = loc.sg.n compound 'in the three stages beginning with the son' (putraka + ādi + pada + traya).
